runner.protocol: unchanged hybrid retrieval, top-k=5, 500 frozen questions, eight independent Modal shards
runner.scope: isolated ChromaDB retrieval component; not end-to-end StatePlane

environment.wrapper_exit_reason: The wrapper compared a weighted average of one-decimal shard percentages (0.97994) against the floor. The raw shard percentages uniquely reconstruct 490/500 exact hits, which is exactly 0.980000.

limitations: This is the frozen isolated retrieval guardrail, not end-to-end StatePlane performance.

The result does not establish a public leaderboard position.
The benchmark runner does not exercise the changed StatePlane/vector_search import path; this is a non-regression receipt, not a product-core delta.
disallowed_claims: Do not call this an end-to-end StatePlane score.
